visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, a woman in a beige and brown paneled shirt and a man in glasses and a black sweatshirt, are shown in a close-up, intently watching a video on a smartphone. The video on the phone screen features a man in a white t-shirt demonstrating a physical movement against a white wall. The indoor lighting is soft and warm, highlighting their expressions of curiosity and focus. (2) The camera transitions to a handheld follow shot in a brightly lit office hallway with grey walls. The woman stands perpendicular to the wall, extending her right arm to touch it firmly. She then pulls her arm back and grips her right elbow with her left hand as instructed by the viral video. Her expression is focused and determined. (3) She attempts to touch the wall again with her arm extended but her fingers fall several inches short of the surface. She displays a shocked expression, with her mouth slightly open and eyes wide, while the man stands behind her, observing with a skeptical look. Bright yellow subtitles and variety-show style text overlays appear on the screen to emphasize the moment. (4) The man takes his turn in the same hallway. He repeats the identical physical steps—touching the wall first, grabbing his elbow with his opposite hand, and then reaching back out. He touches the wall easily without any gap, proving the myth false. He laughs triumphantly and gestures toward the woman. (5) They engage in playful banter while walking. The woman tries to justify her initial failure, gesturing with her hands and suggesting she accidentally leaned her body back. The man jokingly pushes her head toward the wall in a friendly, teasing manner. The PressPlay company logo is visible on the wall in the background. (6) The final shot shows them walking in a studio space with a PressPlay sign. A social media handle @crown_du and a Follow button graphic are overlaid on the screen as they continue to laugh. The man wears blue jeans and white sneakers, while the woman wears tan boots.

A mid-tempo acoustic guitar-driven pop BGM plays at a moderate level, providing a lighthearted atmosphere. The recording quality is crisp. (2) A male voice interrupts with a high-pitched exclamation of disbelief, asking 'How is that possible?' which shows high emotional arousal. The BGM continues steadily in the background. We hear the shuffling of clothes and the sound of footsteps as the characters move into a different space. (3) During the experiment, the female speaker's voice is high in pitch and arousal, filled with excitement and genuine surprise as she performs the challenge. There is a distinct ding sound effect added in post-production when she seemingly fails the challenge to highlight the moment. (4) The man's voice is calmer but humorous as he performs the test himself. We hear the faint echo of the hallway and the rustling of his sweatshirt against his body. He speaks with a confident, teasing tone when he succeeds, followed by the sound of clear, articulated laughter from both individuals. (5) A sharp, comical thud SFX is added in post-production to synchronize with the man jokingly pushing the woman's head. This is immediately followed by a burst of loud, high-valence laughter from both the man and the woman. (6) The audio concludes with casual conversation and banter at a normal conversational volume. The BGM fades out gradually over the final few seconds as the characters walk away. The overall audio quality is consistent with a high-end field recording.
